name: struct
description: Look up your Struct construction data in ChatGPT: projects, site reports, sales, purchasing, accounts and HR. Look up only, with your own Struct permissions.

interface.longDescription:
Struct is a construction management system for contractors in the UAE. Connect your Struct account and ask about your company's work in plain words. ChatGPT looks it up in Struct and answers.

What you can ask about:
- Projects: status, progress against plan, cost position, team, documents and look-ahead schedules
- Site: daily progress reports (DPRs), snags, work inspections, samples and general requests
- Sales: enquiries, quotes, invoices and what clients owe
- Purchasing: purchase requests, RFQs, purchase quotes, vendor POs and inventory
- Accounts: payments, petty cash, statements of account, VAT and bank reconciliation
- People: attendance, manpower, leave and payroll, where your role allows

Look up only. Struct in ChatGPT reads your data. It cannot create, change, approve or delete anything.

Your permissions apply. You sign in with your own Struct login, and ChatGPT sees only what you can see in Struct. Every look-up is recorded in Struct.

All amounts are in AED.

To connect, you need a Struct login from your company.
capabilities: Look up projects, progress against plan and cost position
Find daily progress reports (DPRs), snags and work inspections
Check enquiries, quotes, invoices and what clients owe
Follow purchasing: purchase requests, RFQs, purchase quotes and vendor POs
Review accounts: payments, petty cash, statements of account and VAT
See attendance, manpower and leave where your role allows
defaultPrompt: Which client invoices are overdue right now?
Which DPRs are still in draft?

positive.description: Shows which clients have invoices past their due date
positive.prompt: Which client invoices are overdue right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists each client with overdue sales invoices, largest first: how many invoices are overdue, the total outstanding in AED and how many days the oldest one is overdue. Nothing is changed.

positive.prompt: Show the five newest projects with their client and status.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the five most recent projects, newest first, each with its project number, name, client and status.

positive.description: Finds the projects that are behind plan
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the active projects that are behind their plan, each with its planned and actual progress percentages.

positive.description: Counts the open snags on each project
positive.prompt: How many open snags are there on each project?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the open snag count for each project by status, and lists the oldest open snags with how many days they have been open.

positive.description: Lists the daily progress reports not yet submitted
positive.prompt: Which DPRs are still in draft?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the daily progress reports still in draft, oldest first, each with its project, its date and how many days have passed since that date.

negative.description: Asked to change data: it explains Struct in ChatGPT is look up only and the payment is recorded in Struct
Asked to approve and delete records: it refuses, as nothing can be changed from ChatGPT
negative.prompt: Approve all pending purchase requests and delete the rejected ones.

negative.description: Asked for another company's data: it explains it sees only the signed-in person's own company in Struct
negative.prompt: Show me the projects of other companies that use Struct.

publication.release_notes: First release: look up your Struct data in ChatGPT, covering projects, site reports, sales, purchasing, accounts and HR. Look up only; nothing can be changed from ChatGPT.
